episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Ahsha Hayes enters the wild world of professional basketball when she tries out for the elite L.A. Devil Girls dance team against the wishes of her mother Sloane, a former dancer...

episodes.title: Game On
episodes.summary: Jelena and Olivia engage in a power struggle for control of the Devil Girls while Ahsha works to keep German in her new world.

episodes.title: Out of Bounds
episodes.summary: Ahsha reels from shocking news, to the enjoyment of Jelena while Kyle skirts the rule that she date a player.

episodes.title: Rebound
episodes.summary: Pete and Sloane talk for the first time about the past. In a power play with Olivia, Jelena sets up Ahsha to fail at the Devil annual calendar photo shoot.

episodes.title: Keep Away
episodes.summary: Ahsha demands answers about Sloane's past, Terrence keeps a secret from Jelena, and Raquel misinterprets Pete's intentions toward her.

episodes.title: Lights Out
episodes.summary: The power goes out at Devils Arena before a sold-out game. Kyle counsels German about Ahsha and Sloane shocks Pete again.

episodes.title: Moving Screens
episodes.summary: Olivia is furious when Kyle engages in non-sanctioned Devil Girl behavior while Jelena learns a disturbing piece of news about Terrence and German confronts Derek.

episodes.title: Fast Break
episodes.summary: Olivia sidelines Jelena from choreography, allowing Ahsha an opportunity to shine. German and Ahsha fight over their relationship, and Derek reveals his feelings for Ahsha.

episodes.title: Benched
episodes.summary: Olivia advises Ahsha to reveal more of herself to battle Jelena while Terrence finds himself in trouble with Coach Davenport.

episodes.title: Turnover
episodes.summary: A surprising personnel change takes place within the Devils Organization. Ahsha and Derek get closer while Terrence makes a decision that jolts Jelena.

episodes.title: Game Changer
episodes.summary: In the Season Two premiere, All-Star Ahsha clashes with both Jelena and new boss Sloane while Pete's thrown by the arrival of his estranged wife, Lionel.

episodes.title: Passing
episodes.summary: Ahsha and Derek struggle to keep their relationship secret while Sloane's investigation into Oscar intensifies.

episodes.title: Behind the Back
episodes.summary: Jelena gets new ammunition on Ahsha, Terrence makes a big decision, and Lionel's true motives for coming to Devils Arena are revealed.

episodes.title: Full-Court Press
episodes.summary: Ahsha's spot with the Devil Girls is in jeopardy, with help coming from an unlikely source while Sloane's investigation suffers a setback.

episodes.title: Shattered Glass
episodes.summary: Jelena and Kyle are confronted by unwelcome visitors from their pasts while Ahsha is confronted by what it really means to be Derek Roman's girlfriend.

episodes.title: Blow Out
episodes.summary: Jelena targets Sloane, Pete and Lionel grow closer, and Ahsha takes a very big fall.

episodes.title: Isolation
episodes.summary: Jelena exploits Sloane's absence, and gets an ultimatum from Zero while Raquel reveals a shocking secret to Sloane.

episodes.title: Playing Dirty
episodes.summary: Sloane and Raquel's investigation of Oscar hits a nasty roadblock while Lionel and Pete's relationship takes an unexpected turn.

episodes.title: Unguarded
episodes.summary: Kyle gets tied deeper to Oscar while Ahsha, Jude, Jelena and Pete all face the aftermath of their actions.

episodes.title: Steal
episodes.summary: Jelena makes a surprising decision, Ahsha gets the opportunity of a lifetime, and Sloane exacts some revenge which creates a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: Sudden Death
episodes.summary: German and Ahsha grow closer, Lionel and Sloane have it out, Derek confronts Jude, and Oscar drops a bomb.

episodes.title: Winner Takes All
episodes.summary: The Devils make a final push for the title, and the police make a shocking arrest while bonds are tested before Olivia's murderer is revealed.

episodes.title: Power Play
episodes.summary: The Devil's get ready for their championship ring ceremony while the Devil Girls hold their auditions. Elsewhere, Ahsha finds comfort with German after being fired, and Lionel makes a power move as the new boss.

episodes.title: Blocked
episodes.summary: Jelena's forced to be nice to Vanessa while German must answer to Ahsha. Meanwhile, Sloane prepares to testify against Oscar; Zero gets jealous; Kyle becomes suspicious; and Raquel receives news.

episodes.title: Fake Out
episodes.summary: As a way to raise their power couple profile Jelena plans a masquerade-themed engagement party for her and Terrence.

episodes.title: Good D
episodes.summary: Lionel plans the biggest opening day in Devil's history; Ahsha tries to resist Derek as German spirals out of control; and Terrence and Jelena enlist a new ally. Later, Kyle's movie takes a sexy turn; and a surprising kiss changes everything.

episodes.title: Lockout
episodes.summary: Ahsha, Derek, German, Zero, Jude and Pete face the fallout from their actions. Sloane is forced to revisit her past. And Jelena and Terrence are blindsided by an unwelcome discovery, putting their plan to buy the team in jeopardy.

episodes.title: Carrying
episodes.summary: Tensions between Ahsha, German and Derek reach a breaking point. Jelena faces her worst nightmare. Sloane begs Pete for a shocking favor. Zero hosts an unforgettable party, and Kyle films her movie, with a nasty guest star.

episodes.title: Killer Crossover
episodes.summary: Ahsha and Sloane are in a race against time, and each other. Jelena makes a big gamble, while Terrence tries to right a wrong. Jude and Zero visit Zero's tragic past while Kyle makes a shocking confession.

episodes.title: Upset
episodes.summary: Chase Vincent returns with an agenda while Ahsha loses control. Derek and Kyle are powerless. Lionel's forced to make a desperate move. Meanwhile, Raquel comes clean and Jelena faces her demon.

episodes.title: Loss
episodes.summary: Devils Nation suffers a loss; Lionel's actions reverberate throughout everyone's lives; Zero searches for a face from the past; Jelena struggles with an adversary.

episodes.title: Possession
episodes.summary: Derek's hiding a secret and Ahsha's world will never be the same; Sloane fights for her life; the fight for ownership of the Devils reaches a conclusion.

episodes.title: Slay
episodes.summary: The Devils kick off a new season with an all-new team of Devil Girls. Questions hang over the fates of beloved couple Dersha and Zude, new romances form and someone's life goes up in flames.

episodes.title: Beast Mode
episodes.summary: German makes a surprise return to Devils Nation, at a crisis point for Derek. The rivalry between Jamie and London heats up, as does the sexual tension between Jude and Noah. Jelena's dealt a major blow.

episodes.title: Bad Blood
episodes.summary: The stakes are high as a strip poker game stands between Jamie and London being front and center in the next Devil Girl promo campaign. Derek has redemption and revenge in mind.

episodes.title: Number's Up
episodes.summary: Pax confides in Jamie. German asks Derek to do the unthinkable. Eve decides how far she's willing to go to exact her master plan. the Devil Girls get gritty for charity by performing at an underground vogue battle.

episodes.title: End Game
episodes.summary: What's done in the dark eventually comes to light, and the light couldn't be brighter than at the ISNY Awards show, where secrets are revealed, relationships are exposed and Jude is forced to fight for what he believes in. The battle lines are finally drawn between the LA Devils and a league threatening to rip them apart. ;

episodes.title: Hot Streak
episodes.summary: While the Devils fight to stay alive, several relationships come under attack. Familiar faces return to Devils Arena with very different agendas. New alliances are formed, and a secret is revealed that could derail the future of the LA Devils for good.

episodes.title: Foul
episodes.summary: As the Devils fight for the playoffs, power plays on and off the court threaten to destroy the lives of several members of Devils Nation. One couple splits while another poise to say "I do."

episodes.title: Final Seconds
episodes.summary: As the Devils gear up to take on their biggest opponents this season, Miami, personal conflicts come to a head and Devils Nation will never be the same again. ;
